messages.text: Sprinkler crew found the existing sprinkler main conflicting with the new duct routing at Room 214; it's similar to the condition noted in last month's inspection log, but this one isn't shown on Fire Alarm Riser Diagram FA-501. This is becoming a priority as work proceeds nearby. There will be a cost impact to address this condition. This could affect the overall schedule. Please respond within five business days so we can keep the crew moving.
Reroute to clear the conflict at Room 214 per the attached sketch; proceed once clearance is confirmed. There will be a cost impact to address this condition.

The extent of the existing sprinkler main conflicting with the new duct routing at Room 214 is more than we first reported -- does your direction still cover it? Please respond within five business days so we can keep the crew moving.
